parsed.reason: Description A says metadata is written before the blob, so a failed or interrupted blob write leaves new metadata paired with old bytes (an ordering/atomicity issue). Description B says the mutable default dict `{}` is shared across calls, so setdefault leaks the first content type into later uploads. Different root causes (write ordering versus mutable default argument), even though both touch the metadata lines.
